title: Auth is not implemented
body:
`POST /auth/signup` — JSON body `{"username", "email", "password", "role"}`; returns the created user as `{"id", "username", "email", "role", "created_at"}`. The response must never include `password` or `hashed_password`. Duplicate username returns HTTP 409 with `error: "conflict"`.

`POST /auth/login` — JSON credentials; on success returns `{"access_token": "<jwt>", "token_type": "bearer"}`. On wrong password, return HTTP 401 with body exactly `{"error": "unauthorized", "detail": "invalid credentials"}`.

`POST /auth/token` — OAuth2 password-flow form endpoint; returns the same `{"access_token": "<jwt>", "token_type": "bearer"}` shape.
acceptance_hint: 9 executable checks over the auth surface.
